entities.name: Sebastião Custódio de Sousa Teles
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sebastião Custódio de Sousa Teles, also known as Sebastião Teles, Sousa Teles, or in contemporary Portuguese as Sousa Telles, was a Portuguese politician and military officer. After a career in military logistics and education, he served multiple times as Minister of War, and briefly as President of the Council of Ministers from 11 April to 14 May 1909 during the penultimate year of the Portuguese constitutional monarchy.

entities.summary: Sebastião Custódio de Sousa Teles, also known as Sebastião Teles, Sousa Teles, or in contemporary Portuguese as Sousa Telles, was a Portuguese politician and military officer. After a career in military logistics and education, he served multiple times as Minister of War, and briefly as President of the Council of Ministers from 11 April to 14 May 1909 during the penultimate year of the Portuguese constitutional monarchy.
